# Share threads, messages and runs across the space

## What to build

Let any member open any thread in the space, read its history, continue it, and see its runs. Convert thread, message, run, external-conversation and history queries from `(spaceId, userId)` to `spaceId`, in `apps/api/src/thread-target.ts`, `apps/api/src/routes/threads.ts`, `apps/api/src/runs.ts`, `apps/api/src/mcp-approval.ts`, `packages/db/src/history-retrieval.ts`, `packages/db/src/external-conversations.ts`, and related helpers. Bots and groups are already shared (`getBot` / `getGroupTarget` in `packages/db/src/repos.ts` and `groups.ts` filter by `spaceId` only). Because members can now reach each other's threads, this slice also makes approval and secret asks answerable **only by the person whose run it is** (`run.userId`) until a later slice adds any-member approval for unattended runs. Unread/read state stays as-is (a later slice makes it per member); do not change `Thread.unread` / `lastReadSeq` logic here.

## The sharing rule (decided; apply exactly)

- **Space content**: filter by `spaceId: actor.spaceId` (or `run.spaceId`) only. Drop `userId: actor.userId` from `where` clauses of reads, updates and deletes. Keep `userId: actor.userId` on `create`; it now means "created by".
- **Personal data** (voice, model preferences/credentials/role choices, AI-data consent, notification preferences, push tokens, devices, messaging identities, account secrets/vault with `spaceId: null`, trusted link sites, setting overrides): keep the `userId` filter. Do not touch those queries in this slice.
- Membership is checked once in actor resolution (`requireMembership` from `x-rakazo-space-id`, `apps/api/src/app.ts:915-923`; `authed` middleware runs handlers in `runAsTenant`, `apps/api/src/routes/context.ts:343-354`). Never trust a client `spaceId` without the `asMemberOf` check in `apps/api/src/routes/spaces.ts:35-47`.
- Private spaces have one member, so results there must be identical to before.
- The audit that found these queries covered `apps/api/src`, `apps/worker/src` and `packages/db/src` only. Also run `grep -rn "userId: actor.userId\|userId: run.userId\|userId: input.userId\|userId: scope.userId" packages/adapters/src packages/core/src packages/memory/src` for this slice's models and convert the space-content ones the same way.

Already in the codebase (earlier slices): `Space.kind` (`"private" | "team"`); `scoped()` in `packages/db/src/scope.ts` checks `spaceId` only; RLS policies are space-based for space content; and `seedSharedSpaceFixture(prisma, { kind?: "team" })` exported from `@rakazo/db` (`packages/db/src/shared-space-fixture.ts`) returns `{ organizationId, spaceId, owner: Actor, member: Actor, outsider: Actor, cleanup() }` — one space with an owner and a member, plus an outsider in their own personal space. Use it in every Postgres test here.

## Test pattern for every converted procedure

In a `*.postgres.test.ts` (pattern: `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts` lines 10-75 — `createRouterClient(createRouter({ prisma, env } as unknown as RouterDeps), { context: { actor } })`, fixtures inside `runAsSystem`):
1. owner creates the item through the RPC (or a DB helper);
2. `member` lists/reads/updates it through the RPC → succeeds and sees it;
3. `outsider` with `actor.spaceId = fixture.spaceId` is never produced by actor resolution (it would 401); instead assert the outsider in their own space does not see it, and that a direct read with the shared item's id from the outsider's actor → `NOT_FOUND`.


## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/api/src/thread-target.ts` — `resolveThreadTarget` (330-368, calls getBot/getGroupTarget), connection.findMany 133, chatGroup.findFirst 290, `sendThreadMessage` (725+, creates the user message ~857-860), answer paths at 688, 872, 1075, 1389 (`answeredByUserId: actor.userId`). **Leave the read-state code at 1614-1682 (thread `unread`/`lastReadSeq` updates) untouched.**
- `apps/api/src/routes/threads.ts` — `subscribe` 178-230 (resolves target once, re-checks `stillAuthorized` every 10 s), run.findMany 257 (clientNonce dedupe), `answer` 637-667.
- `apps/api/src/runs.ts` 63 (run.findMany).
- `apps/api/src/mcp-approval.ts` 53, 71, 89 (thread.findMany), 217 (message.findMany with nested `thread: { spaceId, userId }`), 287 (thread.findFirst).
- `apps/api/src/team-chat-bridge.ts` 701 (artifact.findMany via `conversation.userId` — convert to space).
- `packages/db/src/history-retrieval.ts` 405 (run.findMany), 462 (artifact.findMany).
- `packages/db/src/external-conversations.ts` 19 (findMany), 114 (updateMany).
- `packages/db/src/thread-listing.ts`, `packages/db/src/unread-inbox-chats.ts`, `packages/db/src/preview-messages.ts`, `packages/db/src/messages.ts` — check for `userId` filters on threads/messages.
- `packages/db/src/events.ts` 795-1000 — `commitAnswerRunInput`. Today only `instructionUpdate`, `always`, secret dismissal and credential secret cards check `run.userId !== input.answeredByUserId`; "allow once" and "deny" do not:
  ```ts
  if (approvalAsk) {
    if (!pendingAsk.actions?.some((action) => action.id === approvalAnswer)) return null;
    approvalEffect = await tx.externalEffect.findFirst({ where: { id: pendingAsk.approvalEffectId, spaceId: input.spaceId, runId: input.runId, status: "intended" } });
    if (!approvalEffect) return null;
    if (pendingAsk.instructionUpdate) { if (... || run.userId !== input.answeredByUserId) return null; }
    if (input.answer === "always") { if (run.userId !== input.answeredByUserId) return null; approvalUserId = input.answeredByUserId; }
  }
  ```
- `packages/core/src/action-approval.ts` 611-630 — `isSecretAskBlock`, `isApprovalAskBlock`.
- `apps/web/src/pages/shell/transcript.tsx` 533 — `answerableAskIds`; web decides `canAnswer` from it. Find where `answerableAskIds` is computed (API snapshot or client) and make it false for asks on another member's run, so the card renders read-only for others.
- `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` 775-804 (`Thread`, index `[spaceId, userId]`), 806-833 (`Message`), 873-936 (`Run`).

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE thread/message/run/external-conversation/history queries listed above
- **IMPLEMENT**: drop `userId` from `where` for space content; keep on create.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/db check && pnpm --filter @rakazo/api check`

### UPDATE `packages/db/src/events.ts` `commitAnswerRunInput`
- **IMPLEMENT**: when the pending ask is an approval ask (`approvalEffectId` set) or a secret/credential/login ask, return `null` unless `run.userId === input.answeredByUserId`. Free-text questions (plain asks without approval or secret input) may be answered by any member.
- **GOTCHA**: `null` makes `threads.answer` respond `CONFLICT` "This prompt is no longer awaiting an answer"; that is acceptable for now.

### UPDATE answerable-ask computation
- **IMPLEMENT**: expose per-ask answerability for the current actor (run owner only for approval/secret asks) in whatever API payload feeds `answerableAskIds`; web keeps rendering from it.

### CREATE `apps/api/src/shared-threads.postgres.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** with `seedSharedSpaceFixture`: owner creates a bot and sends a message (use the existing send RPC; no model call is needed, assert the message and run rows); `member` resolves the thread target, reads the messages page, sends a follow-up (message created, run queued with `userId = member`); `runs` list for the bot includes both runs; `outsider` gets `NOT_FOUND`; an approval ask on the owner's run (insert an `externalEffect` with `status: "intended"` and pause the run with `pauseRunForInput`) answered by member → `CONFLICT`, by owner → accepted; a plain question ask answered by member → accepted. Private-space regression for thread listing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Any member opens, reads and continues any thread in the space; runs started by each member record that member as `Run.userId`.
- [ ] Approval/secret asks are answerable only by the run's user; others see them read-only.
- [ ] Non-members get `NOT_FOUND`; private spaces unchanged; read-state code untouched.

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm db:generate
pnpm check --affected || pnpm check
pnpm lint
pnpm exec vitest run apps/api/src packages/db/src
pnpm test:integration -- --spec=shared-threads
```

## Project rules that apply (from AGENTS.md)

- Public repo: no secrets, real emails or private URLs in code, tests or fixtures. Test emails use `@rakazo.test`.
- Use top-level `import type`, never inline type imports. Dynamic `import()` only for deferred loading.
- Migrations must work with the previous release running side by side: only add tables/columns (nullable or with a default). Never drop or rename in this task. Folder name `packages/db/prisma/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_snake_name/migration.sql`; use a timestamp after `20261110120000` and unique to this task (the suffix in this task's text). First line is a comment such as `-- Additive: older releases never read or write these columns.`
- Every table with row-level security must be listed in `ROW_SECURITY_MODELS` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:96`), enforced by `packages/db/src/row-security.postgres.test.ts:789-799`. New tables follow `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261109120000_audit_events/migration.sql:57-60` (ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + a `_system` policy on `current_setting('app.rls_bypass', true) = 'on'`) and `20261022120000_row_level_security_tenant_tables` for tenant policies.
- Database access in tests and app code must run inside `runAsTenant` / `runAsSystem` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:27-40`); the vitest setup (`packages/testkit/src/pin-test-env.ts`) fails a suite that touches the database outside them.
- Tests are deterministic and offline. Postgres suites are `*.postgres.test.ts`, skipped unless `VERIFY_DATABASE=1` and `DATABASE_URL` are set (`describe.skipIf(!enabled).sequential(...)`, see `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts:10-13`).
- The API owns authorization and validation; frontends express intent and render state.
- Keep UI copy minimal: no explainer text that repeats the interface. Colors only via `@rakazo/ui-tokens` semantic tokens; reuse `packages/ui-web` components.
- Coordinate across instances through Postgres (transactions, advisory locks, claims), never in-process locks or in-memory counters.
- Do not run the desktop Playwright suite (`pnpm --filter @rakazo/desktop test:e2e`) locally.
